options.label: Apply for a new passport or renew
My application is stuck at police verification

apply.step: Apply on Passport Seva, then book an appointment at a Passport Seva Kendra.

fails.label: Can't get an appointment or the portal fails

pending.step: Track your application with your file number and date of birth. If it stays pending, visit your Passport Office.
pending.authority: Regional Passport Office (verification is done by your local police)

adverse.step: Contact your Passport Office to learn the reason. A clarification can lead to re-verification.
keep: Proof of current address and identity

fails.label: No response from the Passport Office

grievance.step: Register a grievance on Passport Seva, or call the Passport Seva helpline.

q.ask: Have you already filed your RTI?

file.step: File your RTI on RTI Online. It covers Central government bodies; state bodies use their own state RTI system.
file.authority: Public Information Officer of the department that holds the records

wait.step: Wait until 30 days have passed. RTI Online only allows a first appeal after that.

appeal.step: File a first appeal: choose 'Submit First Appeal' on RTI Online.
appeal.authority: First Appellate Authority of the same department

fails.label: The portal won't let me appeal
No reply to my first appeal

second.step: File a second appeal with the Information Commission: the Central Information Commission for Central bodies, or your State Information Commission for state bodies.
keep: RTI and first appeal registration numbers

options.label: Person with disability, worker, disaster victim, or low income

apply.step: Apply for free legal aid through NALSA, or go to the District Legal Services Authority at your district court.
apply.authority: District Legal Services Authority (under your State Legal Services Authority)
keep: Proof of your category or income

check.step: Income limits differ by state, so you may still qualify. Ask the District Legal Services Authority at your district court.

rejected.step: Ask the District Legal Services Authority for the reason, then approach your State Legal Services Authority for a review.

noresponse.step: Contact the District or State Legal Services Authority in person, by post or by email.
noresponse.authority: District or State Legal Services Authority

q.ask: Did you recently move from another district or state?

options.label: No, I need my first ration card

first.step: Apply for a ration card through your state's food and civil supplies department.
first.authority: State Food and Civil Supplies Department

moved.ask: Do you need ration now, or do you want to move your card permanently?

now.step: Go to any ration shop near your new home and collect your ration with your existing card. You don't need a new card for this.
now.authority: State Food and Civil Supplies Department (national portability)

link.label: Mera Ration app: how it works

fails.label: Shop refused, or my entitlement isn't showing

fingerprint.step: Ask the dealer to authenticate another family member on the same card. If they still refuse, register a grievance.
fingerprint.authority: State Food and Civil Supplies Department

grievance.step: Register an online grievance with your district and ration card number, then track it in the Mera Ration app.
grievance.authority: Department of Food and Public Distribution, with your state food department

permanent.step: Surrender your card in your old state to get a surrender certificate, then apply in your new state's ration portal.

register.step: Register on the Udyam portal. Registration is free.
keep: PAN of the business or owner

fails.label: OTP not received or portal error

forgot.step: On the Udyam portal, choose 'Forgot Udyam/UAM number' and verify with the OTP sent to your registered mobile or email.
keep: Mobile number or email used to register

fails.label: OTP not received or number not found

update.step: Log in on the Udyam portal to update your registration details.

support.step: Contact the Ministry of MSME's CHAMPIONS support (Monday to Friday, 10 am to 6 pm), or email champions@gov.in.

q.ask: What does 'Know Your Status' on the PM-KISAN site show?

check.step: Check your status on the PM-KISAN 'Know Your Status' page.
check.authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

ekyc.step: Complete eKYC on the PM-KISAN portal or app, or at a Common Service Centre. Check your status again after 24 hours.
ekyc.authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (verification by your state)

fails.label: eKYC fails or status doesn't change

payment.step: On 'Know Your Status', check the payment status, bank name, UTR number and credit date, and follow the instructions shown there.
payment.authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

verify.step: Follow the instructions shown on 'Know Your Status'. Land and eligibility checks are done by your state's agriculture or revenue office.

q.ask: What does your scholarship application status show?

options.label: Rejected, or no money after approval

pending.step: Ask your institute's scholarship nodal officer to verify your application before the scheme's deadline.

defective.step: Contact your institute or district nodal officer right away so your application can be corrected.

grievance.step: Register a grievance on the National Scholarship Portal and track its status there.
grievance.authority: The ministry or department that runs your scheme

q.ask: Where are you with your Aadhaar correction?

options.label: I need to book or change an appointment

apply.step: Update your details through UIDAI: some fields online, others at an Aadhaar centre.
keep: Proof for the detail you're correcting

rejected.step: Call UIDAI on 1947 to find out why, fix the problem, then submit a new update request.

appointment.step: Book, reschedule or cancel your appointment on UIDAI, at least 24 hours ahead, using the same mobile number or email.
keep: Mobile number or email used to book

complaint.step: Raise a complaint with UIDAI: call 1947 or email help@uidai.gov.in.

fraud.step: Call 1930 or report on the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal right away, and contact your bank's official fraud line.
fraud.authority: Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre, with your police and bank

phone.step: File a police complaint, then block your phone's IMEI on Sanchar Saathi so it can't be used.
phone.authority: Your local police, and the Department of Telecommunications

apply.step: Apply on your state's e-District or citizen-services portal, or at a Common Service Centre.
apply.authority: State Revenue Department (Tehsildar or SDM office)

stuck.step: Check the reason on your state portal's application status page, then submit the missing document or correction to the issuing office.
stuck.authority: Tehsildar or SDM office (varies by state)

office.step: Visit the Tehsildar or revenue office, or your state e-District helpdesk, with your application number.
